seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Wheat Ridge, CO: holiday celebration at The Green on 38th, rec center parties, Baugh House history and more.
lede: Wheat Ridge keeps Christmas close to home, with city recreation parties, a holiday gathering at The Green on 38th and a historical society celebration at the Baugh House.
celebrates: Wheat Ridge Parks and Recreation anchors the season with a holiday celebration at The Green on 38th, a public gathering space on West 38th Avenue, and family parties at the Wheat Ridge Recreation Center, including a Noon Year's Eve party and a Snowball Splash in the pool. The Wheat Ridge Historical Society adds a quieter, old-fashioned afternoon at the Baugh House, where neighbors trade cookies and gifts and sing carols. Local businesses such as Kangaroo Ranch and Hashtag also host kid-friendly holiday programs that are carded on this page.
lastyear: The Wheat Ridge Historical Society's Holiday Celebration at the Baugh House has become a yearly tradition. Its 2024 edition ran on Saturday, December 14, from 10 am to 2 pm, and guests were invited to wear a holiday sweater for prizes and bring cookies or gifts for a cookie exchange and a white elephant gift exchange, with caroling and holiday fun. The society holds its Second Saturday Socials at the Baugh House, and the 2026 edition is listed for December 12.
facts: Wheat Ridge is best known for its Carnation Festival, which takes its name from the years after World War II when the town was home to a thriving carnation industry. The Wheat Ridge Historical Society's Baugh House, at 11361 West 44th Avenue, and its grounds were designated Jefferson County Landmark properties on June 3, 2024, so a December visit to the house is also a visit to a landmark.
trains: Wheat Ridge families who want a Christmas train ride usually head to Golden, where the Colorado Railroad Museum runs its Polar Express train ride in the holiday season, carded on this site. RTD light rail also runs through the west metro, so check RTD's trip planner for a car-free outing to downtown Denver. Georgetown Loop Railroad's Santa trains are a longer drive up into the mountains.

faq: What is the Wheat Ridge Historical Society Holiday Celebration?

It is a free-flowing afternoon at the Baugh House with a holiday sweater contest, a cookie exchange, a white elephant gift exchange and caroling. The society's calendar lists the 2026 edition for Saturday, December 12, from 10 am to 2 pm at 11361 West 44th Avenue.

The Green on 38th is a public gathering space at 7101 West 38th Avenue in Wheat Ridge. The city's Parks and Recreation calendar lists a holiday celebration there, with refreshments and s'mores among the activities. Check the city's holiday celebration page for any schedule changes before you go.
Does Wheat Ridge have its own Christmas parade?

This page does not carry a Wheat Ridge Christmas parade for 2026 because none was verified on a host website. The Carnation Festival is the town's big parade event, and it takes place in summer. Holiday fun in town centers on recreation center parties, The Green on 38th and the Baugh House.
What can toddlers do at Wheat Ridge Christmas events?

Small children can join the Noon Year's Eve party at the Wheat Ridge Recreation Center, a midday celebration designed so little ones do not have to stay up late. The Holiday Celebration at The Green on 38th also offers s'mores and refreshments in an outdoor setting, so dress warmly.
